cim_eredeti: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions (AITX) Targets January 2027 Cash Breakeven
szoveg_eredeti:
Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions targets monthly operating cash breakeven in January 2027, assuming approximately 2.7% monthly revenue growth. It targets cash-spend reductions of approximately $345.0K per month by January 2027 versus its August 2026 run rate; the target is not a GAAP profitability projection.

This is an early-stage turnaround and liquidity update, with the company pursuing internal cash-breakeven milestones amid stated financing and going-concern risks. The next catalysts are reported progress against the January 2027 milestone, realized revenue growth and cost reductions, and any finalized additional balance-sheet measures.

Based on the original press release from Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions, Inc. distributed by TMX Newsfile.

prioritas.indok: Csak gépi pontozás (az AI-pontozás nem futott le); érdemes ránézni. Forrás-tapasztalat: -7. A forrás P3-as híreiből eddig kb. 20%-ot fogadtál el.
